 Lakers guard emerges as early trade candidate after just four games 
 2026-10-28 15:38 
 Jaden Hardy could be traded by the Lakers as they might look to improve their backup-center rotation.

 Los Angeles Lakers guard Jaden Hardy could find himself on the move once again, just a few months after arriving in Los Angeles.

 NBA reporter Jovan Buha said he expects the Lakers to try to trade the 24-year-old as the team searches for ways to improve the back end of its roster, particularly at backup center.
 "Jaden Hardy is not, I think, a serious rotation player," the LA insider said on Buha's Block .
 Hardy has appeared in only one game this season, playing seven minutes in the Lakers' opening win against the Golden State Warriors. He finished with three points and two rebounds and has not established himself as part of JJ Redick's regular rotation.
 "I think the back three guys on the roster, which are [Kevon] Looney, Bronny [James], and Hardy, any of those three, in my opinion, are worth potentially waiving," Buha said.
 However, Buha separated Hardy from the other two because he believes the Lakers will first attempt to find value for him on the trade market.
 "I think they're gonna try to flip Hardy," Buha said.
 Credit IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect - Scanpix 
 Hardy arrived in Los Angeles through Ayton trade
 The Lakers acquired Hardy and second-round picks in 2031 and 2032 from the Washington Wizards in exchange for Deandre Ayton.
 Buha believes the Lakers' most pressing problem is at backup center and said the team may need to open either a two-way or regular roster spot to bring in another big man.
 "I would not be surprised if they potentially make some sort of move with either a two-way or roster spot to try to add someone because it's clear that this is a massive hole [on] the roster," Buha said.
 "I think they probably have to address it via trade ultimately."
 The Lakers have started the season with three wins in four games. They face the LA Clippers on Wednesday night.
